dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-intensity perimeter bands forming interlocking 'O' and 'C' topologies. Primary structures exhibit sharp pixel transitions between light-colored outlines and dark-centered interior voids. Edge geometry is jagged and varies in thickness, particularly prominent in the anterior-dorsal quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixels are located primarily in the ventral-anterior region. These clusters lack internal gradients and are smaller than the macro-annuli, appearing as solid-fill points amidst the ringed patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most dorsal-anterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary larger geometric relationship is defined by a chain of five primary centroids extending from the top-left to the center-right, forming a loose, convex arc.
